main_text.p: Et sic Romanus Pontifex, qui aliorum iudex in Concilijs sedere debet, post Photium sedens iudicabitur; & etiam si iusta non iussisse iudicabitur, condemnabitur, & punietur. Romani iussa, atque sententiae grauissimum condemnatorum iudicium subibunt: condemnati, ac reiecti irrogabunt multam: quia ille neque aequum, neque iustum postulauit. Sic [illegible, ~12 letters], & Ecclesiasticae hierarchiae vniuersus ordo inuertitur. Et ego dicam Synodum similia decernentem, Oecumenicam, legitimam, & genuinam esse? Non sum stipes, nec fungus. Alia ab his & longe diuersa genuina Concilia praecinunt. Adrianus Papa Epistola ad Imperatorem Basilium lecta in Octaua Synodo Actione secunda.

Βουλόμεθα ἡ διὰ τῆς ὑμετέρας [?] ἀσφαλείας [?] ἐκ Καισαρείας ἐν τοῖς αὐτόθι πλεσθεῖσι συνελθοντι [?], ὡς αἱ ἡμέτεροι [?] Αʹ ... [illegible, ~30 letters] ... ἀλλὰ ἐπὶ τὰ [?] ... ἀνακρίσεως [?] ... ἐπὶ τοῖς [?] ... νόμοις. Voluimus autem per vestrae pietatis industriam Constantinopoli nu-

page.notes: The Greek passages are only partly legible at this scan resolution. Words I could not read letter by letter are marked [?] or as illegible, and I have not filled them from memory. The Latin is clear except where noted. The long s is transcribed as plain s (e.g. "iussisse", where the printed form is a ligature-like s/f). The catchword "nu-" sits at the lower right of the page. Stray marks at the foot of the scan are ink specks, not text, and are left out.
